notes:
Video Studio now uses an offline graphics renderer automatically for supported map shots, an illustrated glacial rebound cross-section and music videos that call for a speaker moving with the beat. Other scenes continue through the footage generator. Both kinds of shot can appear in one video.

Long screenplays can reuse matching illustrated shots. A four-minute Great Lakes test with three distinct illustrations, a repeated map and generated scene audio finished in 2 minutes 2 seconds on the development PC. Its finished MP4 decoded to 3,840 frames. Timing depends on the mix of graphics and generated footage.

This release also fixes timing at cuts between graphics and generated footage and keeps quick graphics renders out of estimates for generated footage.
